bible_refs.note: Quoted: as Moses lifted up the serpent, so the Son of man must be lifted up.
The bronze serpent on the wood.
Hung on wood; possible with Gal 3:13.

pass_a_gloss: for the Savior himself says: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so the Son of man must be lifted up, according to the type of the serpent hung upon wood by Moses, signifying nothing other than the Savior's passion insofar as he was hung upon wood — it is clear that according to the type of the serpent the passion will be taken and not according to the type of the pascha.
pass_b_english: For the Savior himself says: "As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of man be lifted up," (John 3:14) according to the type of the serpent hung on the wood by Moses, signifying nothing other than the passion of the Savior insofar as he was hung on wood. It is clear, then, that the passion will be taken according to the type of the serpent and not according to the type of the Passover (Numbers 21:8–9) (Deuteronomy 21:23).
